family: sign(3 X1 + 3 X2 + 2 sum rare >= 5) on 0/1 physical bits; sign output +/-1
domain: m rare bits in {3,4,5,6}, p1=p2=1/2, epsilon in {1/(8m),1/(16m),1/(64m),1/(256m)}; deterministic epsilon=0 checked separately
symmetry: No truth-table quotient. All proper blocks checked by explicit cofactor rows; analytic proof groups blocks by core/rare counts.
arithmetic: Exact Fraction product spectra through E[f product(X_i-E X_i)]/v_S on sign bits, integer dyadic cells. Natural log signs bounded by rational atanh intervals.
targets: physical spectrum Parseval, Delta and R
independent_check: pivotal probabilities and c12 from binomial count versus full product expansion
analytic_extension: All m>=3 and 0<epsilon<=1/(8m), proved separately; finite checks do not establish this extension.
